summary: Re-ran every finding from the three review lenses on the current head (ac4cae6ee) against the live clara_l07 database. All ten blocker/major/minor findings (SPEC-L07-01..05, F1, ADV-01..06) are genuinely fixed, verified by direct re-execution, not by trusting the fix report's prose: packages/db's four touched test files (client-birth-wall, merge-alias-lane, sandbox-marker, opening-ledger-source) run 32/32 pass under the full 87-gate chain; operation-census+rig-isolation 32 pass/0 fail/1 correctly-skipped; the merge/identity batteries (counterparty-merge-pr-1, wave-a-merge, counterparty-identity) 44/44 pass; wave-b/rig-invariants/rig-events/audit-actor-role 56/56 pass; the whole apps/web unit suite is 4846 pass/0 fail/2 skipped (was 8 fail pre-fix, confirmed clean now, including the do-action-floors/firm-capability-floors/firm-scope-db-pins cells the 0289 dynamic-SQL fix targeted); the onboarding-begin-keyboard.test.tsx file carries the new D3 cell and is 3/3 pass; e2e client-create-walk is 4/4 pass; pnpm typecheck is clean; CI=true GITHUB_ACTIONS=true pnpm lint exits 0; check-frozen-workflows, check-parts-parity and check-dead-citations are all clean. Source-level checks confirm the claimed mechanisms are actually in the code, not just asserted: 0287 carries the pg_advisory_xact_lock(203005008, ...) ahead of the candidate read (ADV-01), the create_client catalogue comment names SUPERSEDED/open_client_onboarding/#899 (SPEC-L07-01/04), OnboardingBeginCard.tsx now imports and calls openClientOnboarding with a null acknowledgement (SPEC-L07-02), 0289 splices a second CLR11 anchor lifting the firm test out of the combined guard (ADV-03), opening-ledger-source.test.mjs's premise is now a >= floor (ADV-04), and merge-alias-lane.test.mjs's no_legacy_writer census reads the value at recorded_via with a depth-aware, quote-aware parser and a vacuity-proving crafted-body case (ADV-05). The fix round's own diff (61b7463f..ac4cae6ee, 11 files, 781+/88-) touches only the files the ten findings named, confirming no scope creep. Nothing above minor remains open, and nothing new broke.

findings.title: SPEC-L07-01's underlying acceptance criterion (no granted role reaches an unwalled client-minting verb) is still not fully met for #899 -- correctly disclosed, not a code defect
findings.evidence: The fix round did not withdraw clara.create_client's grant or re-point its body (both require an estate-wide fixture migration the fix report scopes out as a successor contract). What it fixed is the BLOCKER-level defect the review actually found: the census previously asserted the residual AS satisfying AC3. Re-run p899.census.granted_client_minters_and_the_one_residual (cell 12) now explicitly asserts the criterion is OPEN while the array is non-empty ('It BOUNDS the residual; it does NOT claim the ticket's no-unwalled-granted-minter criterion is met, because it is not' -- read verbatim from tests/client-birth-wall.test.mjs:379). packages/db/README.md's client-birth-wall section and 0287's own header say the same in matching language. A successor contract ('Move the rig's client fixtures off clara.create_client, then withdraw its grant') is filed in the fix report. This is the honest-disclosure path the original finding's required_fix implicitly allows when full closure is infeasible in-scope; it is not something this lane can close without touching ~48 shared fixture files outside its ticket.
findings.outcome_for_integrator: Not blocking. #899 should be tracked as PARTIAL on this one AC with the filed follow-up, exactly as the fix report, the migration header and packages/db/README.md all already say.

findings.outcome_for_integrator: Not blocking (ADV-09 was already 'note' severity and this gap is honestly named, not hidden). The integrator should run the five listed spawners against a cloned database before the from-scratch release proof, per the fix report's own instruction.
